verdict: Approved for images 257–262 (printed pp.255–260): end of the Malkhuyot/Shofarot verses, the Sabbath piyyut 'אנוסה לעזרה' (all of the קול stanzas), and Shofarot verses through Ps. 150:5. Nothing is clipped and nothing overlaps. Hebrew (vocalised, with bold חזן/קהל cues) and English are readable throughout. Each stanza row and verse row lines up Hebrew to English, and no rows are orphaned or out of order across page breaks. Running heads ('חזרת התפלה') and page numbers alternate correctly between recto and verso. The ↗ scan-link markers sit inline at matching points in both languages. The rule and the bilingual heading 'בשבת / On the Sabbath' on 257 are placed correctly. This range doesn't include the priestly-blessing introduction, the missing-source label, the ending, or the credits/bibliography, so none of those were checked here.
